newsitem.title: UK: UK's Heywood Williams sees progress in '97.
newsitem.headline: UK's Heywood Williams sees progress in '97.

text.p: British building and automotive products group Heywood Williams Plc said on Wednesday it expected to make further progress in 1997 despite a slower-than-expected start to the year.

"Favourable conditions are still forecast for our principal markets in the United States and in the United Kingdom," executive chairman Ralph Hinchliffe said. "Despite uncertainties surrounding the United Kingdom political situation and the strengthening of sterling, I expect the group to make further progress in the year," he added in a statement.
The firm posted pre-tax profits of 37.2 million stg in 1996 after a 1.8 million stg charge versus 38.6 million stg in 1995, which included a gain of 9.9 million stg.
Heywood's shares rose 5.0p to 259 by 0831 GMT.
